description: Planetary hours for a moment and place: the unequal hour in effect (its ruler, day/night, hour number 1-24, start/end UTC), the ruler of the planetary day, and the full 24-hour ruler sequence. Hours split the day (sunrise to sunset) and night (sunset to next sunrise) into twelve each; the day ruler is the weekday ruler and the hours follow the Chaldean order. Needs lat+lon. Returns available:false above the polar circles when the Sun does not rise or set that day.
